```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(caret)
library(nnet)
source("get_clean_data.R")

orig_data = get_clean_data()
data = orig_data

```


```{r}

fatal_data$CrashSeverity = as.factor(ifelse(fatal_data$CrashSeverity == "Fatal", "Fatal", "Not Fatal"))

fatal_data = model.matrix(~., data = orig_data)

colnames(fatal_data)

model.log = glm(CrashSeverity ~ ., data = fatal_data[,-5], subset = train.inds, family = binomial)

summary(model.log)

```

We can see from our model on all our variables that many of the categories are actually not very useful.
